paragraphs.en: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Code 是一个位于你终端中的智能体编码工具，它理解你的代码库，通过执行日常任务、解释复杂代码和处理 git 工作流来帮助你更快地编码——所有这些都可以通过自然语言命令完成。

paragraphs.en: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows -- all through natural language commands. Use it in your terminal, IDE, or tag @claude on Github.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Code 是一款驻留在你终端中的智能体编程工具，它理解你的代码库，通过执行常规任务、解释复杂代码和处理 git 工作流来帮助你更快地编写代码——所有这一切都可以通过自然语言命令完成。 你可以在终端或 IDE 中使用它，也可以在 GitHub 上通过 @claude 标记它。

paragraphs.en: We welcome your feedback. Use the /bug command to report issues directly within Claude Code, or file a GitHub issue .
paragraphs.zh: 欢迎您提供反馈。 使用 /bug 命令直接在 Claude Code 中报告问题，或在 GitHub 上提交 issue。

paragraphs.en: Join the Claude Developers Discord to connect with other developers using Claude Code. Get help, share feedback, and discuss your projects with the community.

paragraphs.en: When you use Claude Code, we collect feedback, which includes usage data (such as code acceptance or rejections), associated conversation data, and user feedback submitted via the /bug command.
paragraphs.zh: 当您使用 Claude Code 时，我们会收集反馈，包括使用数据（例如代码接受或拒绝的情况）、相关对话数据，以及用户通过 /bug 命令提交的反馈。

paragraphs.en: We have implemented several safeguards to protect your data, including limited retention periods for sensitive information, restricted access to user session data, and clear policies against using feedback for model training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们已实施多项保障措施来保护您的数据，包括对敏感信息设定有限的保留期限、限制对用户会话数据的访问，以及明确的禁止将反馈用于模型训练的政策。
